title: Chevening Fully Funded UK Government Scholarships
eligibility: International students from eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, living allowance, flight tickets)
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic record
description: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in the UK across any subject area.

title: Google STEP Internship 2025
eligibility: First or second-year undergraduate students pursuing Computer Science or related STEM fields
qualification: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
description: STEP (Student Training in Engineering Program) is a developmental internship for first- and second-year undergraduate students focused on providing real-world software engineering experience.

title: Associate Software Engineer
eligibility: Recent graduates or students graduating within the current academic year
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
description: Work on scalable cloud solutions, design modern APIs, and collaborate on world-class software products in an inclusive, high-impact environment.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Entry-level developers with demonstrable project experience in modern web frameworks
qualification: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Git source control
description: Contribute to GitLab's open-source DevOps platform asynchronously from anywhere in the world, maintaining user interface features and front-end components.

title: Imagine Cup 2025 Global Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 18+ enrolled in high school or higher education institutions
qualification: Open to all current undergraduate and graduate students worldwide
description: The Imagine Cup is a global technology competition empowering students to create innovative solutions using AI and cloud technologies to solve real-world problems.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone interested in learning computer science concepts and programming
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan that teaches how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
